r7.sentence: On 2026-10-22, on the Claude Agent SDK path with claude-sonnet-5-5, with 3 runs per cell and a model grader, surviving-lines at 4b65d05 had the highest total of six arms (itself, project-pilot with and without its command, mcp-git-historian, k41n/busfactor, plain Claude) on 5 new held-out tasks (15.00 of 25 against 11.33 for the best rival, better-of pp/ppi) and on 11 public tasks (49.67 of 51 against 41.67), but it did not win every task (held-out C1 tied plain Claude; public T1 and E5 were not strictly above every rival), so the preregistered gate failed and F9 and F6 were not run.
departures: The public set was graded by a model on every outcome criterion for six arms together, not by the round 4 and 5 script checks on four arms; public numbers are not comparable to rounds 4 and 5.
Two public cells (T1i ppi, bf) have one criterion with fewer than two valid votes (`err=1`); it is left out of the mean.
No cell of an earlier round is reused. The SDK path differs from the earlier CLI path only in that the desktop application's Artifact tool and artifact-diagramming skill are absent.

The held-out writer's tasks were not read by the controller; the product changes of round 7 (R7-1 to R7-4) were driven by the seen sets (N1 to N4, H1 to H3) only. The tie on C1 and the T1 and E5 misses were not investigated before the round.
Cost logged: 31.20 USD (stop line 36, maximum 40). F9 (Haiku, Opus) and F6 were not run because the gate failed. No tolerance exists in Rule B; one-criterion differences decided C1, T1 and E5.
Evidence folder completed after the round (2026-10-22) from the local raw runs: traces are scrubbed copies; the unscrubbed originals stay local.
r7.cost: Logged `claude -p` cost of the whole round: 31.20 USD (runs C 6.33 + public 11.80, grading 2.73 + 5.52, diagnostics and subagents about 5).

r8.sentence: On 2026-10-22, on the Claude Agent SDK path with claude-sonnet-5-5, with 3 runs per cell and a model grader, surviving-lines at dabc18f had the highest total of six arms (itself, project-pilot with and without its command, mcp-git-historian, k41n/busfactor, plain Claude) on 5 new held-out tasks (19.33 of 25 against 13.00 for the best rival, better-of pp/ppi) and on 11 public tasks (50.67 of 51 against 43.00; Rule A and Rule B both pass on the public set), but Rule B failed on the held-out set (D1 and D2), so the preregistered gate failed and F9 and F6 were not run.
departures: Public grading was completed after the budget stop line (34 USD) had been crossed, on the owner's instruction: the cells whose grader replies did not parse (T1-2, T1i-3, E1-2, E3-1, plus one that failed again in the first re-ask) were graded again with the same `gate-grade.py`, same grader model and same prompts; no new run. Replaced failed replies are kept in `grades/public/reasks/`. First published public result (before completion): ours 50.33, Rule B failed on T1 (tie with pp at 3.67). Completed result: ours 50.67, Rule B passes. The held-out result did not change.
The run driver skipped grading after each batch because of a shell status bug; grading was run afterwards by a separate script with the same grader code and the same budget check.

The controller saw two README entries of the held-out writer (d4 and d5 hazard summaries) on a terminal while checking that the file existed; this was after the product code was frozen and changed nothing.
One implementer run used `git checkout -- hooks` on its own uncommitted edit, which the handoff rules forbid. Nothing else was touched.
No cell of an earlier round is reused. The SDK path differs from the earlier CLI path only in that the desktop application's Artifact tool and artifact-diagramming skill are absent.

Product change of round 8 (R8-1 to R8-5) came from the diagnosis of seen cells (C1, T1, E5, C3). The losses on D1 and D2 were not investigated. Diagnostic runs (ours, one run each, not scored) are not part of any table.
F9 (Haiku, Opus) and F6 were not run because the gate failed. Rule B has no tolerance.
r8.cost: Logged `claude -p` cost of the whole round: 35.34 USD (runs D 6.63 + public 12.62, grading D 2.84 + public 5.62 + 0.25 for replaced replies, diagnostics, implementer, reviewer, fixer, writer and check about 7.4).
